description.value: Hiraku Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Coquitlam offering an extensive menu of sushi rolls, sashimi, aburi nigiri, donburi, noodles, and hot pot. The kitchen emphasizes fresh, high-quality ingredients and carefully crafted presentation across a broad range of traditional and fusion Japanese dishes. Touring cyclists passing through the Coquitlam area would find a full sit-down or takeout Japanese meal option here.
